items.name: theme
items.title: AMA Theme
items.description: Install first, once per app. AMA Precast tokens (logo navy #1A2250, website navy #0F0A35, concrete greys, signal yellow on navy only, cobalt actions), light and dark, density modes, type roles, status chip styles and the Tailwind v4 wiring that removes the default palette so only AMA tokens exist. Then add to app/globals.css, after @import "tailwindcss" and "tw-animate-css": @import "./ama/theme.css";

items.name: utils
items.title: cn() with AMA merge config
items.description: Replaces lib/utils.ts. cn() that knows the AMA type roles, density sizes, radii and shadows so className overrides never drop a style.

items.name: status
items.title: Status keys
items.description: Lifecycle status keys, labels and icon names generated from the tokens. Mirrors the elements.status enum.

items.name: lint
items.title: AMA lint rules
items.description: ESLint rules that enforce the guideline: only AMA classes, no arbitrary values, no opacity states, no outline-none, no warning colour in table rows, no raw <select>. Spread amaRules() into eslint.config.mjs.

items.name: compat
items.title: Migration shim (ama-os only)
items.description: TEMPORARY. Maps Tailwind defaults still used by ported prototype code (text-sm, text-xs, bg-white, bg-black/50, rounded-2xl, shadow-xl) onto AMA values. Import after theme.css and lint with amaRules({ compat: true }), which warns on every use. Delete when the count reaches zero.

items.name: agents
items.title: Agent rules
items.description: The AMA UI rules for coding and design agents (Claude, Cursor, Figma). Install into every AMA repo.

items.name: logo
items.title: AMA Logo
items.description: The AMA Precast logo as an inline SVG component with token colours. tone="reverse" on navy chrome, variant="mark" for the top bar. Never retype the wordmark.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Prototype API unchanged. Heights follow density, hover and disabled use tokens, focus uses the global outline.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Counts and tags only. Lifecycle statuses use StatusChip.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Card surface with type roles.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: 16px box, 24px hit area, 3:1 border.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: 16px text below md (no iOS zoom), density height, invalid state.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Matches Input.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: Label role.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: 3:1 off state, 24px hit area.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Compact by default, density-driven rows and cells, selection with indicator bar, TableCheckboxCell (whole cell toggles).

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Overlay token, z-100, 28px close target.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: Right-docked detail panel, overlay token.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Floating layer z-110 (opens above dialogs).

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: Floating layer z-110, compact items, overline labels.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Matches Input. Use instead of raw <select>. Optional leading icon, and an icon-only mode. Floating layer z-110.

items.name: confirm-dialog
items.title: Confirm Dialog
items.description: Replaces window.confirm. Requires dialog and button.

items.name: prompt-dialog
items.title: Prompt Dialog
items.description: Replaces window.prompt. Requires dialog, button, input and label.

items.name: status-chip
items.title: Status Chip
items.description: The only way a lifecycle status is shown: colour family, Lucide icon and label together. Requires theme and status.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Success, warning, info and destructive feedback. Icon plus left rule, never a pill, never in table rows.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Underline tabs for switching views of one record. Active is the foreground label plus a 2px primary indicator. Optional count, mention and unread markers via props. Height follows density (44px+ in touch). Not for picking between peer options inside a panel.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: Segmented control for 2 to 4 peer options inside a panel. Selected is the card fill plus a border. Height follows density. Not for page-level navigation: use tabs.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: 28px circle: the person's photo, or initials in primary on accent. Always paired with the person's name; never the only identifier.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Short supplementary text on hover or focus for icon buttons and truncated values. Inverse colours, floating layer z-110. Never the only copy of important information. Wrap the app once in TooltipProvider.

items.name: stage-cloud
items.title: Stage cloud icon
items.description: AMA glyph: a free-shape stage outline with a cloud edge, the line Draw stage draws on the plan. Lucide grammar and API (size, strokeWidth, currentColor stroke). The only non-Lucide icon.

items.name: colour-swatch
items.title: Colour Swatch
items.description: Stage cloud colour picker: a radio group of round 28px buttons, each the stage-cloud glyph in one of the chart tokens 1 to 5. Selected shows the ring. Every swatch needs an aria-label naming the colour.

items.name: person-row
items.title: Person row
items.description: Pattern/Person row: one person in Settings, Users and roles. Avatar (photo or initials), name, email and company, the role badge, and Invited until the invite is accepted. With onSelect the whole row is one 64px button with a chevron. Draws only; who is listed and their role come from the app.

items.name: phone-page-header
items.title: Phone page header
items.description: Pattern/Phone page header: the sticky 56px header for phone pages that are not a panel (Settings and similar). Back, the title on one line, and one optional icon action, each a 44px target. The page's main action belongs in the bottom bar.

items.name: code-input
items.title: Code input
items.description: Pattern/Code input: the 8-digit email sign-in code, one digit per box. Digits only; paste or the phone's one-time-code autofill fills every box; onComplete fires on the last digit; invalid draws destructive borders. Never checks the code: the app does.

items.name: shell-rail-item
items.title: Shell rail item
items.description: Pattern/Shell rail item: one item in the app rail on navy chrome (Views, Documents, Activity, Settings, Reader). 72 x 56, icon over a caption; active draws the yellow signal indicator and sets aria-current; the focus ring is yellow on chrome. asChild wraps the app's link.

items.name: shell-panel-row
items.title: Shell panel row
items.description: Pattern/Shell panel row: one row in the shell's side panel and menu sheet (views, documents, Settings sections). Optional icon, label, meta and pin star; active fills the selected row colour with the left indicator. Height follows the density. asChild wraps the app's link; the pin is its own button.

items.name: shell-chrome-button
items.title: Shell chrome button
items.description: Pattern/Shell chrome button: a button on navy chrome (Open menu, Scan, update). Icon only is a 44px square needing a label; showLabel makes a filled 44px pill with the label. Yellow focus ring.

items.name: shell-avatar
items.title: Shell avatar
items.description: Pattern/Shell avatar: the account button at the bottom of the app rail. 44px target, 32px circle on chrome with the initial or photo. A button, for the account menu's trigger.

items.name: shell-menu-tab
items.title: Shell menu tab
items.description: Pattern/Shell menu tab: one tab across the top of the shell's menu sheet (Views, Documents, Activity). Icon over label, 48px; active is foreground with a 2px selected indicator underneath. role=tab.

items.name: shell-activity-item
items.title: Shell activity item
items.description: Pattern/Shell activity item: one entry in the shell's Activity tab: the comment, then project · panel and how long ago. With onSelect it is a button that opens the thread.

items.name: preview-bar
items.title: Preview bar
items.description: Pattern/Preview bar: shown while Admin or IT preview another shell as someone (Front door 10.9). Names the shell and the person, with Exit. Info soft fill, info border underneath, under the page header. Draws only; the app makes the preview read only.

items.name: qa-answer
items.title: QA answer
items.description: Pattern/QA answer: Pass, Fail or N/A in one tap. Default for desktop rows, Touch (full width, 48 high) for phones. The chosen segment takes the success, destructive or muted soft colour. Draws only; who may answer and what an answer does come from the app.

items.name: qa-item
items.title: QA item
items.description: Pattern/QA item: one checklist item on the Visibuild QA tab. Views Answer, Review (read only) and Builder (Planned, In progress, Complete; never Failed); states Open, Pass, Fail, N/A; sizes Desktop row and Touch card; Not synced cloud icon. Draws only; permissions, answering and sync come from the app.

items.name: photo-tile
items.title: Photo tile
items.description: Pattern/Photo tile: a cover-cropped photo thumbnail, 56 or 72. States Photo, Add (dashed, opens the camera or file picker), Uploading (progress bar) and Not synced (cloud badge). With onSelect it is a button. Draws only; uploads and sync come from the app.

items.name: qa-ring
items.title: QA ring
items.description: Pattern/QA ring: QA progress as a ring. Compact 16, Touch 24, Large 64. Arc is done, a red arc and dot show a failed check, a ticked full ring is complete, a dashed grey ring is not scheduled. Draws only; the counts come from the app.

items.name: metric-card
items.title: Metric card
items.description: Pattern/Metric card: a tab summary card with label, a 28px value row and a sub line; give progress for the bar beside the value. Use 3 to 5 in a row. Draws only; the numbers come from the app.

items.name: qa-defect
items.title: QA defect
items.description: Pattern/QA defect: the defect raised when a QA item fails, inside the failed row. Note with Close defect (outline until a fix photo is added, then primary), defect photos, a divider and fix photos with an Add tile. States Open, Fix added, Closed. Draws only; closing and uploads come from the app.

items.name: visibility-tag
items.title: Visibility tag
items.description: Pattern/Visibility tag: who can see a comment, Internal (Lock) or External (Globe), with an optional menu chevron.

items.name: visibility-toggle
items.title: Visibility toggle
items.description: Pattern/Visibility toggle: the Internal or External choice in the Activity composer.

items.name: activity-tabs
items.title: Activity tabs
items.description: Pattern/Activity tabs and Activity tabs touch: the staff (All, Mentions, Comments, Alerts, Log) or builder (All, Raised, Comments, Updates) filter row.

items.name: activity-log-line
items.title: Activity log line
items.description: Pattern/Activity log line: one automatic entry in the Log with icon, sentence, who and when, and a visibility tag.

items.name: activity-comment
items.title: Activity comment
items.description: Pattern/Activity comment: avatar, name, age, visibility, body with @mention, photo grid with +N, reply footer, unread state and indented replies.

items.name: activity-composer
items.title: Activity composer
items.description: Pattern/Activity composer: Post to, visibility toggle or builder post type, input, add photo and send, in seven modes with attached photos.

items.name: raised-item
items.title: Raised item
items.description: Pattern/Raised item: a defect, change request or issue raised on a panel, with state colour, actions and Open in Visibuild.
